upstream_artifacts.signature_evidence: provenance/strata-feed.json(.sig), engine-component.json, public update keys and receipts/official-bundle-verification.json plus independent-openssl-verification.json
upstream_artifacts.normalization_note: Public upstream metadata is retained byte-for-byte, including CRLF and detached signatures. Source/public SHA256 identities verify those exact copies; local research receipts use documented text normalization/redactions.

redaction_policy: Operator homes, fleet private IPs/hostnames, UUIDs, maintenance owners and literal credential values are replaced in public text. Boolean api_key feature flags are retained. Raw local copies stay local.
reproduction_note: Public source paths are placeholders. Set model/assets/config paths for your own machine. This package contains benchmark code and synthetic evidence; vendor weights/runtime bundles are external pinned dependencies.
